title: Warm Sugar Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: A classic Peruvian dish featuring tender beef heart, marinated in a mixture of spices and herbs, grilled to perfection and served with a touch of sugar, this recipe is a sugar-free friendly version using powdered sugar substitute, served in an en-croute form as anticuchos.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the sliced beef heart to the marinade and mix well to coat, cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, thread the marinated beef heart onto skewers.
Grill the anticuchos for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
While the anticuchos are cooking, mix the powdered sugar substitute and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Once the anticuchos are done, brush them with the sugar mixture and serve immediately.
Serve the anticuchos hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
For an en-croute form, wrap each anticucho in a piece of puff pastry and bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
